title: Design System: RAGInGoa — Hacker House Goa 2026 Brand

display.purpose: H1 headline and footer title only — the one face that renders the wordmark's Latin + Devanagari as one family.

label.purpose: Buttons, badges, stat numbers, phase-ribbon segments, log rows — anything tracked-uppercase or a live measurement.

shadows.name: card-day
shadows.purpose: Real offset elevation for every cream/white card in day theme.

shadows.name: card-night
shadows.purpose: Card elevation in night theme (green page ground, cream cards).

motion.name: sun-pulse
motion.purpose: Fires on the hero sun illustration when a query starts (phase transition from idle).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Send-query icon button — golden-yellow fill, dashed border, pill shape.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary" aria-label="Send question"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="22" height="22"><path d="M4 12h15M13 6l6 6-6 6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:50px; height:50px; border:2px dashed #084A29; border-radius:999px; background:#FEE101; color:#0B3D22; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter:brightness(1.05); }

components.name: Outline Pink Button
components.description: Mic / secondary action button — cream fill, pink border, inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background:#FFFFFF; border:2px solid #FF0080; border-radius:999px; color:#C2005F; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; font-weight:700; padding:0 20px; min-height:50px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:#FF0080; color:#FFFFFF; }

components.name: Verdict Stamp
components.description: Tri-state answer badge: CONFIRMED (yellow) / UNCERTAIN (pink) / DECLINED (black).
components.css: .ds-stamp { border-radius:999px; padding:8px 18px; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:13px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.16em; background:#FEE101; color:#0B3D22; }

components.name: Phase Ribbon
components.description: Chevron-clipped pipeline-stage tracker, translating the brand's timeline ribbon into a live indicator.
components.html: 01 IDLE02 LISTENING03 TRANSCRIBING
components.css: .ds-phases { display:flex; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-phase { flex:1; text-align:center; padding:9px 14px 9px 22px; margin-left:-12px; color:#4C6B57; background:#FFF3CE; clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 12px) 0,100% 50%,calc(100% - 12px) 100%,0 100%,12px 50%); opacity:.7; } .ds-phase.past { opacity:1; color:#0B6839; } .ds-phase.now { background:#FEE101; color:#0B3D22; font-weight:700; opacity:1; }

components.name: Instrument Card
components.description: Base cream/white card with real offset shadow, used regardless of theme.
components.css: .ds-panel { background:#FFFFFF; color:#0B6839; border-radius:16px; padding:24px; box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(11,60,35,.14), 0 2px 4px rgba(11,60,35,.08); }

narrative.overview: This is not an invented visual world — it is the actual Hacker House Goa 2026 event brand kit applied to a live, functioning voice-RAG demo console. The brand is a retro Goan-beach travel-poster identity: forest green and cream sections, hot pink and golden yellow as equal-weight accents, hand-drawn line illustration, chevron/ribbon shapes, pill buttons, and a bold poster serif paired with tracked mono labels. A green hero band bookends a cream working area and a green footer band, so a judge recognizes the actual event brand within the first second.
keyCharacteristics: Forest green and cream alternate as full-section grounds, never mixed into a muted brand color
Hot pink and golden yellow stay at full saturation, never diluted into pastel tints
Rozha One carries every display headline, including the wordmark's गोवा, at its native weight only
IBM Plex Mono carries every label, badge, and data readout
Chevron-ribbon shapes, dashed borders, and an x-divider row are drawn directly from the brand's own graphic devices
Real offset card shadows, never a zero-offset glow

rules.name: The Four-Role Rule
rules.body: Only green, cream, pink, and yellow (plus black for declined) ever appear as fills. No fifth color, no gradient between them.

rules.name: The Card-Is-Always-Cream Rule
rules.body: Every card/panel is cream or white in both themes; only the page ground swaps between cream (day) and green (night).

rules.name: The No-Synthetic-Style Rule
rules.body: Rozha One has one real weight and no italic. Never fake-bold or fake-italic it.

rules.name: The Real-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Card shadows always carry a real offset and blur, never zero-offset glow.

rules.name: The Chevron-Ribbon Rule
rules.body: Sequential/stage UI uses the chevron-ribbon shape, never a plain segmented bar.

dos: Do keep green and cream as full-section grounds.
Do keep pink and yellow at full saturation.
Do use Rozha One at its native weight only.
Do keep every card cream/white regardless of theme.
donts: Don't invent a fifth accent color or a gradient between the brand colors.
Don't use a zero-offset glow shadow anywhere.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading.
Don't reuse black for anything but the declined/closed state.
